claim_scope: v4 matches v3 declared planning/checking/reader/binding/runner/harness hashes and recipe objects. Whole pipeline identity differs; package/rendering and freeze-verifier code changes are explicitly outside this byte-identity claim.
limitations: A manifest-to-manifest comparison is not a fresh full_weights verification of current filesystem bytes. Launch must independently require_frozen(v4,full_weights=True).
Package generation and freeze verification execute on the planning path but are changed; identical end-to-end wall time or output package bytes is not asserted.
New extension coordinator and generator are separately registered outputs, not covered as byte-identical frozen implementations.
This proof says nothing about seed or map-input non-overlap.
method: Compare declared SHA256 inventories in two published freeze manifests; no executable or map input is opened
